prompt: Design a two-leaf hinge in OpenSCAD, drawn in its assembled position. The hinge axis runs along X through the origin and the hinge is 36 mm wide. There are three knuckles of 4 mm radius on that axis: leaf A owns X = 0 to 12 and X = 24 to 36, leaf B owns the middle one, shortened by a 0.3 mm gap at each end so the knuckles never touch. A 4.2 mm pin bore runs through all of them. Each leaf carries a flat plate 3 mm thick, 20 mm deep, 36 mm wide, centred on the axis height: leaf A's plate extends in -Y and leaf B's in +Y, joined to their own knuckles by webs that clear the other leaf entirely. Put the parts in modules named leaf_a() and leaf_b(), name the bore diameter bore_d, and call both modules at the top level.
